description:
Activate Dakmor Salvage's cycling ability by paying {R} and discarding it.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Dakmor Salvage ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
